what_constrained: Pebble emery 200x228 layout, T9 candidate timing, and emulator clock/capture behavior
what_worked: Host-tested text model, native screenshots, fixture rollover, and fresh verifier review
what_differently: Capture animation frames with a controlled single emulator driver and test Clay visually before release

what_constrained: Clay emulator Save navigation did not deliver a visible watch update
what_worked: Independent AppMessage color tests, reinstall persistence capture, and a 24-hour regression fixture
what_differently: Confirm Clay Save on physical hardware before publication

what_constrained: The Pebble store release was immediately public while physical settings behavior remained unverified
what_worked: Native screenshot set, independent package review, explicit published CLI submission, and byte comparison of the store PBW
what_differently: Test Clay Save on hardware and record battery impact for the next release

what_constrained: Pebble SDK GIF capture resets shared emery persistence and the public listing caches screenshot order
what_worked: Backed up and hash-verified emulator state, captured true rollover frames, edited screenshots without a binary release, then checked public cache propagation
what_differently: Keep screenshot-only edits in the dashboard and wait for public gallery refresh before declaring delivery

what_constrained: The first GIF contained previous-minute frames that only became misleading when the animation looped on the public listing
what_worked: Inspected the loop seam frame by frame, trimmed five 09:12 frames, compared the clock region across all frames, and verified the corrected public asset
what_differently: Review the first and last frames together before publishing a looping time animation

what_constrained: Two visual models had to share the T9 layout and saved colors; a running QEMU retained its theme despite the GIF tool deleting persist files
what_worked: Separated model palettes from custom colors, used a licensed bitmap source for the 3310 style, inspected native frames, captured after a clean emulator start, and compared public assets with local media
what_differently: Stop QEMU before default-theme GIF capture and inspect the public description after cache refresh

what_constrained: The 3310 font lost punctuation bearing and made utility digits too tall for the original keypad spacing
what_worked: Preserved getmask2 vertical offsets, restored compact utility text, drew tapered oval keys at v1 row positions, and compared public media with native output
what_differently: Inspect typography at native scale before store capture, especially punctuation and label-to-keypad gaps

what_constrained: The RAZR minute words and T9 sequence crowded the frame and keypad, and a new minute-00 wording choice needed to preserve the existing default
what_worked: Reduced only the two-line RAZR word and sequence scales, captured both wording states natively, checked persistence after reinstall, and compared the published PBW and gallery assets
what_differently: Test the densest two-line minute in each theme before publishing screenshots

what_constrained: The new RAZR wave geometry had to keep tiny legends readable, while restoring Original as the new default without remapping saved Nokia and RAZR choices
what_worked: Used the first-release commit as the Original specification, assigned Original a new persisted value, inspected native screenshots for all three styles and an active key, and compared public PBW and gallery assets
what_differently: Treat display-style values as stable data before adding or reordering choices

what_constrained: The first RAZR interpretation treated separate sculpted key outlines as four continuous waves, and two special key legends were missing
what_worked: Cropped the user reference to the keypad, matched its left/center/right stroke topology, checked native 200x228 screenshots and active rollover, obtained fresh review, and verified public assets byte for byte
what_differently: Check key topology and all twelve legends against an enlarged reference before implementing or publishing a themed keypad

what_constrained: The reference keypad had asymmetric individual strokes and the prior version amplified that imbalance at 200x228; fixed y coordinates also made gaps vary when the hour word shrank
what_worked: Mirrored the outer strokes around x=100, centered three labels and fills, computed minute positions from rendered line heights, and inspected one-line, two-line, long-hour, Original, and Nokia captures
what_differently: Check symmetry and vertical rhythm across short and long time phrases before preparing release media

what_constrained: Prefix-based sizing caused layout jumps; emulator host ticks interrupted long-hour captures; the clearer phone photo exposed missing digit hierarchy
what_worked: Measured completed phrases, tested Save/Cancel/startup events, used isolated default-off native fixtures, aligned digit origins, and reviewed static and highlighted native frames
what_differently: Validate long 24-hour phrases from the first typed character and reproduce the reference hierarchy as well as its outlines
